title: How far the school district hole opened
subtitle: The district budget deficit for 2025-26 at three points in the year, per district data
source: Austin Independent School District data, via Community Impact
alt: Bar chart of the Austin Independent School District budget deficit for the 2025-26 school year at three points: 19 million dollars when the board adopted the budget, 121 million dollars after a mid-year amendment, and 105 million dollars in the final unaudited figure reported to the board on Aug. 27
